create_subsample_dataset: create a SubsampleDataset that subsamples a fairseq dataset by a specified size ratio
build_subsample_with_shuffle: build a SubsampleDataset with shuffle enabled to randomize batch ordering during training
test_subsample_getitem: test the SubsampleDataset __getitem__ method to verify it returns correct subsampled examples
review_ordered_indices: review the SubsampleDataset ordered_indices method to understand batch construction ordering logic
summarize_prefetch: summarize the SubsampleDataset prefetch method that delegates prefetching to the wrapped dataset
